property_summary: In the reference, lockInGuess(bytes32) can only be called successfully by an address that currently has no active guess (guesses[address].block == 0); the mutant inverts that check so it only allows calls when a guess already exists, breaking that universal property for some callers/inputs.
change_summary: Replace the require that prevents re-locking (guesses[msg.sender].block == 0) with its negation, allowing lockInGuess to only be called when a guess already exists, changing post-call stored guess state for callers with prior guesses.
